messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 39):
"""
IRDAI/ACT/CIR/MISC/069/04/2021dated 01.04.2021 (Where modification of the pricing of the Group Product is proposed, Submit separately as an Annexure, percentage difference between existing and modified premium rates for each rating factor) Certification. The Insurer shall enclose a certificate from the Appointed Actuary, Chief Compliance Officer, countersigned by the principal officer of the insurer, as per specimen given below:( The language of this should not be altered) CERTIFICATE BY APPOINTED ACTUARY: “I, (name of the appointed actuary), the appointed actuary, hereby solemnly declare that the information furnished above is true. I also certify that, in my opinion, the premium rates, advantages, terms and conditions of the above product are workable and sound, the assumptions are reasonable and premium rates are fair and the rates proposed are viable.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
